demoWriteClicks.reason: Apply to all writes the new Target VWC values to every selected station; it is shown highlighted with its result, never sent anywhere.

vo.text: Change the Target VWC of many stations at once, either by replacing every value or by shifting them all by the same amount.
vo.next_text: Tick the checkbox on each station row. Ticking an area or hole row cascades the selection to everything beneath it, so you can take a whole hole in one click.
